scripts.build: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run build && npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run typecheck && npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-frontend run typecheck

scripts.test:api: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run build && node --test tests/integration/health.test.mjs
scripts.test:db: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run build && node --test tests/integration/database.test.mjs
scripts.test:auth: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run build && node --test tests/integration/auth.test.mjs
scripts.test:requests: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run build && node --test tests/integration/requests.test.mjs
scripts.test:allocation: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run build && node --test tests/integration/allocation.test.mjs
scripts.test:lifecycle: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run build && node --test tests/integration/lifecycle.test.mjs
scripts.test:statistics: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run build && node --test tests/integration/statistics.test.mjs
scripts.test:hardening: npm --prefix dhaka-tesla-pool-backend run build && node --test tests/integration/hardening.test.mjs
